Ben wants to be a nurse in the future. Ben's favorite animal is the bird. It takes twenty minutes to get to the bus stop by bike. Best of all, bees fly from flower to flower.
Ben hopes to visit London one day. Ben learned a lot about art. The weather was snowy that day. For example, the ring road takes you round the city.
Ben usually has fish for breakfast. Ben and Anna had great fun there. Both of them like fish and water. Welcome to our new home.
Life is full of small surprises. Anna is interested in dancing. The bus stop is one of the best places in the city.
